_README: Curated food/drink/timing quotes, one per (substance, item) pair. Never hand-written: every entry is produced by scripts/build_food_guidance_curated.py, which fetches the substance's own live openFDA label, extracts a qualifying sentence with the same logic app/api/food_guidance.py uses for the live path, and writes it verbatim. An entry with no quote is never created -- the loader (app/api/food_guidance.py's load_curated) rejects any entry it finds without one, as a second line of defense. Fields: substance (registry id), item, quote (<=300 chars, verbatim), label_field, set_id (openFDA set_id when available), date_fetched (ISO 8601), verified (stays false until a human opens the source).
